title: PipelineSampler
description: Samplers supported by the Phase C toy pipeline stages.

oneOf.description: Identity sampling, preserving Phase A behavior.
Shift sampling, preserving Phase B behavior inside a pipeline stage.

ShiftSampler.description:
Shift sampler: destination `(x, y)` samples source `(x + dx, y + dy)`.

Positive `dx` samples from a source cell to the right of the destination;
positive `dy` samples from a source cell below the destination. Coordinates
shifted outside the source surface return `None` and skip the write.

dx.description: Horizontal source offset relative to the destination coordinate.

dy.description: Vertical source offset relative to the destination coordinate.
